name: Cafe Morning
notes: a narrow cafe interior, morning sun through the front window, a wooden counter, steam from the machine

compiled.description: the small bright dining room of a tiny family diner - exposed red brick down one long wall, sunflower-yellow painted walls, mismatched framed pictures and green pickle drawings hung close together, six or seven small tables with speckled green terrazzo tops and bentwood chairs, fresh flowers in little vases on every table, potted plants and window boxes along a tall sunlit front window, a stainless kitchen pass and a pastry case at the back, a shelf of children's books, lived-in and worn, a narrow cafe interior, morning sun through the front window, a wooden counter, steam from the machine

time_frags.dawn: at dawn, low gold light and long shadows
